name: leetcode-tracker
description: Local-first desktop practice tracker with BYOD JSON Lines problem ingestion, weekly study strategies, multi-provider AI recommendations, and Markdown/Obsidian/Notion knowledge export.
author: Yide Milo Li

scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle-server && npm run desktop:prepare-runtime && npm --prefix apps/desktop run tauri build
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle-server && npm run desktop:prepare-runtime && npm --prefix apps/desktop run tauri dev
scripts.test: node --test tests/server-static-security.test.ts tests/desktop-platform.test.ts tests/social-catalog.test.ts tests/phase18-theme-palettes.test.ts tests/tag-mastery.test.ts tests/adaptive-review.test.ts tests/focus-session-planning.test.ts tests/practice-reliability.test.ts tests/phase4-closure-verification.test.ts tests/phase5-closure-verification.test.ts tests/planning-remediation.test.ts tests/time.test.ts tests/catalog-store.test.ts tests/notes-store.test.ts tests/bundle-backup.test.ts tests/server-api.test.ts tests/server-settings-ai.test.ts tests/server-settings-llm.test.ts tests/llm-audit.test.ts tests/review-regressions.test.ts tests/practice-store.test.ts tests/server-practice-api.test.ts tests/planning-domain-store.test.ts tests/server-planning-api.test.ts tests/dashboard-domain-store.test.ts tests/server-dashboard-api.test.ts && npm run test:web && npm run test:desktop
scripts.test:web: node --max-old-space-size=4096 --import tsx --test tests/web-theme-palette.test.tsx tests/web-focus-session-mastery.test.tsx tests/web-refactor.test.tsx tests/web-components.test.tsx tests/web-planning-components.test.tsx tests/web-dashboard-components.test.tsx tests/web-shortcuts.test.tsx tests/encouragement.test.ts tests/web-desktop-ui.test.tsx tests/web-notes-workspace.test.tsx
